mapperNodes.xml: <select id="selectContracts" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P18ProjectContractSyncTask$Contract">SELECT id,company_code,contract_no,deleted FROM com_contract WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} <choose><when test="query.keys != null and !query.keys.isEmpty()">AND (<foreach collection="query.keys" item="key" separator=" OR ">(company_code=#{key.companyCode} AND contract_no=#{key.contractNo})</foreach>)</when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose><if test="!query.preview"> FOR UPDATE</if></select>

<select id="selectRelations" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P18ProjectContractSyncTask$Row">SELECT id,tenant_id,project_id,contract_id,relation_role,source_system,source_table,source_record_key,effective_from,effective_to,status,version,creator,create_time,updater,update_time,deleted FROM com_project_contract_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} <choose><when test="query.keys != null and !query.keys.isEmpty()">AND (<foreach collection="query.keys" item="key" separator=" OR ">(project_id=#{key.projectId} AND contract_id=#{key.contractId} AND relation_role='RELATED')</foreach>)</when><otherwise>AND 1=0</otherwise></choose><if test="!query.preview"> FOR UPDATE</if></select>

<insert id="insertProjectContract">INSERT INTO com_project_contract_relation (id,tenant_id,project_id,contract_id,relation_role,source_system,source_table,source_record_key,effective_from,effective_to,status,version,creator,create_time,updater,update_time,deleted) VALUES <foreach collection="rows" item="row" separator=",">(#{row.target.id},#{row.target.tenantId},#{row.target.projectId},#{row.target.contractId},#{row.target.relationRole},#{row.target.sourceSystem},#{row.target.sourceTable},#{row.target.sourceRecordKey},#{row.target.effectiveFrom},#{row.target.effectiveTo},#{row.target.status},#{row.target.version},#{row.target.creator},#{row.target.createTime},#{row.target.updater},#{row.target.updateTime},#{row.target.deleted})</foreach></insert>

<select id="oneSourcePerTargetIndex" resultType="int">SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.statistics WHERE table_schema=DATABASE() AND table_name='int_base_sync_binding' AND index_name='uk_int_base_sync_binding_target' AND non_unique=0</select>

<select id="selectContracts" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P18ProjectContractSyncTask$Source">SELECT id AS contractSourceId,contractNo,projectGroupCode,createTime AS contractCreateTime,createBy AS contractCreateBy,updateTime AS contractUpdateTime,updateBy AS contractUpdateBy FROM pm_project_contract ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectGroups" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P18ProjectContractSyncTask$Source">SELECT id AS groupId,projectGroupCode AS groupProjectGroupCode,projectGroupName AS groupProjectGroupName,projectType,createTime AS groupCreateTime,createBy AS groupCreateBy,updateTime AS groupUpdateTime,updateBy AS groupUpdateBy FROM pm_project_group WHERE projectType='10' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectMembers" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P18ProjectContractSyncTask$Source">SELECT id AS memberId,projectGroupCode AS memberProjectGroupCode,projectCode AS memberProjectCode,mergeBranchMark,smsProjectCode,createTime AS memberCreateTime,createBy AS memberCreateBy,updateTime AS memberUpdateTime,updateBy AS memberUpdateBy FROM pm_project_group_relationship ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}</select>

<select id="selectProjects" resultType="cn.iocoder.yudao.module.pms.integration.basesync.task.P18ProjectContractSyncTask$Source">SELECT p.projectId AS originalProjectId,p.projectCode AS originalProjectCode FROM pm_project p JOIN (SELECT CAST(projectType AS BINARY) AS typeKey,CAST(projectCode AS BINARY) AS codeKey,MAX(projectId) AS projectId FROM pm_project GROUP BY CAST(projectType AS BINARY),CAST(projectCode AS BINARY)) chosen ON chosen.projectId=p.projectId WHERE p.disabled=0 AND p.effectiveTo IS NULL AND p.projectType='10' ORDER BY p.projectId LIMIT #{limit}</select>
